title: Spicy Norwegian Frittata
description: A flavorful and spicy twist on a classic Norwegian dish. This frittata is perfect for brunch or a quick dinner.
instructions: 2. In a large skillet, cook the sausage over medium-high heat until browned. Remove from heat.
3. In the same skillet, add the onion and bell peppers and cook until softened.
4. Add the garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
5. Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk together. Add salt and pepper to taste.
6. Pour the egg mixture over the cooked sausage and vegetables in the skillet.
7. Sprinkle the cheese on top of the eggs.
8. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes or until the eggs are set.
9. Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes.
10. Slice into wedges and serve hot.
